package wiredimpl

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"example.test/auth"
	"example.test/httperr"
)

type figures interface {
	Read(ctx context.Context) ([]int, error)
}

type checked struct{}

func (checked) Read(ctx context.Context) ([]int, error) {
	if err := auth.Require(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return []int{1}, nil
}

type unchecked struct{}

func (unchecked) Read(ctx context.Context) ([]int, error) { return []int{1}, nil }

type Handlers struct{ source figures }

func New() Handlers { return Handlers{source: unchecked{}} }

func (h Handlers) GetFigures(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	out, err := h.source.Read(r.Context())
	if err != nil {
		httperr.Write(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}
